title: Archon's Duel
description: A two-phase strategy/action game where Light and Dark battle on a shifting board and clash in real-time arena combat.
prompt:
Core Concept
The game features two asymmetrical factions: the Light Side (unicorns, valkyries, wizards) and the Dark Side (goblins, dragons, sorceresses). While the factions have different units, their overall strength is balanced.

Phase 1: The Strategy Board (Turn-Based)
The primary view is a 9x9 grid, operating much like a traditional board game.

Movement: Players take turns moving one piece at a time. Some units walk on the ground (blocked by other units), some fly (can pass over units), and the leaders can teleport.

No Automatic Captures: Unlike chess, landing on an opponent's square does not automatically destroy them. Instead, it triggers Phase 2, teleporting both units to the Arena.

Magic: The leader of each faction (Wizard for Light, Sorceress for Dark) can sacrifice some of their own health to cast spells instead of moving. Spells include healing units, reviving dead units, teleporting, or shifting time.

Phase 2: The Arena (Real-Time Combat)
When two pieces clash, the board transitions to a full-screen, top-down 2D combat arena.

Action Combat: Players take direct control of their units using a joystick (or keyboard). You must manually aim and attack.

Asymmetrical Units: Every unit plays differently. Knights use melee swords, Banshees have an area-of-effect aura that damages anyone standing near them, and Manticore shoot projectiles.

Cooldowns: You cannot spam attacks. Every attack has a wind-up and a cooldown, forcing players to time their strikes carefully.

Obstacles: The arena generates walls and barriers. These barriers fade in and out of existence, meaning a wall you are hiding behind might suddenly disappear, leaving you exposed.

Health: Both units have a health bar. The winner of the arena combat returns to the strategy board to claim the square, but they keep whatever damage they took during the fight.

The "Light Cycle" Mechanic
This is Archon's defining feature. Some squares on the strategy board are permanently white or permanently black, but many are "Light Squares."

These squares constantly shift color, cycling from white, to cyan, to green, to blue, to black, and back again, changing one shade every turn.

Stat Buffs: The stats (health, speed, damage) of your units in the combat arena are directly tied to the color of the square they were standing on when the fight started. Light units are incredibly powerful on pure white squares but heavily nerfed on black squares, and vice versa.

Win Conditions
A player wins the game by either:

Destroying all enemy pieces on the board.

Successfully occupying the five "Power Nodes" (special glowing squares on the strategy board) simultaneously.
